question:

Which statement describes the plotted line?

choices.A: a curved line of increasing positive gradient starting at the origin of the graph
choices.B: a curved line with negative gradient of decreasing magnitude
choices.C: a straight line parallel to the pressure axis
choices.D: a straight line parallel to the volume axis
